description: Run every check saving a model's eBay multi-variation listing would run, writing nothing: each article's required fields and price in the marketplace currency, the variation axes (colour and/or size, named as the eBay site names them), duplicate or missing variation values, the category (suggested from the title, or the saved listing's), whether it allows variations, item condition, required item specifics, one shipping policy for all articles, business policies and inventory location. Returns ready, marketplaceId, categoryId, axes, variationCount and issues (reason, message, skus). Needs a marketplace but not the owner's arming. Reads eBay. Use save_ebay_variation_listing once ready is true.

marketplaceId.description: eBay marketplace id (EBAY_IT, EBAY_DE…) for a FIRST save, when the connection sells on several. A saved listing keeps its marketplace; omit it then.

model.description: The product model: its code — the productGroupId get_product and search_products return for every article of it — or its id. Its active articles on the eBay channel become the listing's variations.

name: inspect_ebay_variation_listing
title: Check a model's eBay variation listing
